writing_turn.answer:
[writing-specialist]

# Grow Something Delicious This Saturday

Our free tomato-planting workshop is back! Join your neighbors this Saturday, October 31, at 10:00 a.m. in the community garden behind the library.

We'll cover choosing seedlings, preparing beds, spacing, staking, and watering. Master Gardener volunteers will lead small groups and share varieties that thrive in our climate, including compact cherry tomatoes that do beautifully in containers and balcony pots.

Bring sun hats and gloves if you have them. We'll provide seedlings, tools, soil, and refreshments, so no green thumb is required. Children are welcome with an adult.

Space is limited, so sign up at the library front desk by Friday. Everyone who plants will head home with a seedling and a printed care calendar.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
